title: Marlowe & Finch Home Delivery Fee Schedule: Base Fee and Item Allowance by Service Level
content:
Every Marlowe & Finch Home Delivery booking carries a base delivery fee, in US dollars to the cent, that covers up to a set number of items; each item on the booking beyond that number is charged an extra item fee. The fee is charged per booking, and a booking is one order delivered to one address.

## Schedule

| Service level | Base delivery fee | Items covered by the base fee | Fee for each further item | How the fee is charged |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Curbside Delivery | $39.00 | 3 | $10.00 | Per booking, one order to one address |
| Threshold Delivery | $59.00 | 3 | $15.00 | Per booking, one order to one address |
| Room of Choice Delivery | $99.00 | 3 | $25.00 | Per booking, one order to one address |
| White Glove Delivery | $149.00 | 5 | $35.00 | Per booking, one order to one address |
| White Glove Delivery with Assembly | $189.00 | 5 | $45.00 | Per booking, one order to one address |
| Premier White Glove with Haul-Away | $249.00 | 5 | $45.00 | Per booking, one order to one address |

## Notes to the schedule

1. **Base delivery fee.** The base fee of the booking's service level, covering up to the number of items shown in the third column.
2. **Items covered.** A whole number of items. The first three service levels cover 3 items; White Glove Delivery and the two levels above it cover 5.
3. **Further items.** The fee in the fourth column is charged once for each item beyond the covered number. An item count at or below the covered number incurs no further item fee.
4. **Basis.** All six service levels charge on the same basis: one fee per booking, where a booking is the large items of one order going to one address.

## Illustrations (hypothetical item counts)

- A Threshold Delivery booking with 3 items: the base fee of $59.00 alone, as 3 items are covered.
- A Threshold Delivery booking with 5 items: 2 items lie beyond the 3 covered, so the further item fee is $15.00 multiplied by 2, or $30.00, in addition to the $59.00 base fee, a total of $89.00 for these two charges.
- A White Glove Delivery booking with 5 items: the base fee of $149.00 alone.
- A White Glove Delivery with Assembly booking with 7 items: 2 items beyond the 5 covered, so $45.00 multiplied by 2, or $90.00, in addition to the $189.00 base fee.

Other charges that may arise on a booking (stairs, distance, Saturday, haul-away, rescheduling and redelivery) are not part of this schedule.
